answer: Rotating witness lottery. Each period every identity must answer a challenge whose seed is drawn from a public beacon after the window closes, so no one can pre-solve or target it. Passing requires a live stored key and timely response, which acts as a bridge between offline keys and real participation. A missed round drops the score toward a nadir and revokes voting weight until re-earned. This signal lifts the per-clone cost above a one-off purchase, since each identity must be independently maintained and monitored across random rounds.
